# Route table snapshot

<!-- generated by: sierra routes --config config/sierra.config.js -->

Generated from `src/routes` by `sierra routes`. **Do not edit.**

A route table is a naming convention over a file tree — a rename moves a URL,
a `_module.mesa` one directory up rewraps every page beneath it, and nothing
in the app refers to either by name. Regenerate after moving a file and read
the diff: a URL that changed without a change you meant to make is a link
somebody else already published.

```
37 routes · 3 layouts · target spa · trailing slash always
```
